reviews.author: ethan ghymn
reviews.text:
I first learned about Bobae Banjeom when I visited Costco's Sangbong branch because it was a new restaurant nearby. I didn't really like jjamppong, so I wasn't that interested, but I came across it again on Instagram and had some good memories of the soybean paste at Se-Ah, a soybean paste restaurant that I recently stopped by. I feel like there are a lot of stores like this these days, so I was wondering if it would be a similar experience. I was already full after leaving Super Duper Burger, but on my way to Gangnam Station, I decided to go for the last course before heading home. Decided to stop by.

The store was located in a back alley near Gangnam Station. It may have been a chain store, but the exterior of the store was clean. When I entered, the clerk told me to sit down in a comfortable seat. I sat down, and after a while, he brought me slightly spicy and savory chai and pickled radish with lettuce.

There are various seasonings on the table and you order using a tablet, but you get beef.
Jjamppong and Cream Jjamppong seemed to be famous, but I was already full and curious about the basic menu, so I ordered Bobae Jjamppong and paid for it right away, so I paid using my tablet.

There is a self-service bar on the counter in front of the kitchen, and a free coffee machine is also available at the entrance.

There weren't that many customers, but seeing as they didn't come out right away, I thought they must have cooked something on the spot and waited. After some time, Bobae Jjamppong came out on a robot and I got up and picked it up.

When I took a quick look, I was worried that I would be able to eat it all because the volume was good, as was the bowl. When I stirred it with chopsticks, I saw a lot of seafood such as mussel meat, pork, and squid with the shell removed, and onions.

First, when I tried to taste the soup, I could clearly smell the pepper and wondered if it was a clear type, but it had the right thickness and was quite spicy. There was red pepper powder on the table, but I think some people sprinkled more red pepper powder on it.

The noodles are thin and relatively soft and stretchy, and have a subtle sweetness due to the large amount of sautéed onions.

The mussels seem to be frozen, but there are still several of them. The squid may also be frozen, but it has a springy texture rather than a crumbly texture, which may be because it is not a giant squid.

Since I had already eaten two hamburgers, I tried to empty the soup as much as possible, but I couldn't empty it all, so I only ate the ingredients and got up, leaving the soup behind.

I made an iced Americano from the coffee machine and drank it after leaving the store. The taste of the coffee was weak, but it was free so there was nothing to complain about.

Overall, it seemed like a Jjamppong restaurant that seems to be popping up a lot these days, so I stopped by. The volume was good and it felt like they didn't skimp on the ingredients, but the taste wasn't really my type and I wouldn't necessarily visit again, so it was okay.

reviews.text:
Hot Pot Nara Gangnam Branch
I'm not the type of person who 'loves' hot pot very much, but I always reach for it because it's a conscientious choice among unlimited refills.
Even though it was a long time since I visited, I was still satisfied.
19,800 won per person on the weekend is an acceptable price in Gangnam.

Ordering is QR these days.
It is a typical unlimited refill method where you just choose the soup base at the table and the rest is taken from the self-service bar.
Perhaps because this restaurant does a good job, the rotation of vegetables is good.
I especially like cabbage, and the moment I bit into the soft cabbage soaked in red soup was the highlight of the day.

The meat overall is between ‘okay’ and ‘good’.
However, I was concerned about the smell of jeonjeong (jeongak) and pork, and you need to focus on using the tongs to avoid getting caught in the fatty parts of beef pork belly.
On the other hand, the lamb meat did not have an overpowering smell, so it was easy to eat a lot.
Of course, white soup has a weak scent, so the smell of meat tends to be stronger.

Another advantage of this house is the sauce bar.
Filled with plenty of cilantro, it's heaven for cilantro lovers.
Just by blending to your taste with peanut sauce, marinara paste, chili oil, and garlic, you can come up with dozens of combinations.

The regret is Huaao tone.
I chose the basic level 2, but the spiciness was too sharp rather than numbing, and as you add vegetables and meat, the broth quickly loses its consistency and a bland section arrives.
In this case, it is better to rearrange the tone by requesting additional base or seasoning refill.

Nevertheless, after eating a lot of vegetables and a moderate amount of meat, the conclusion is, “Let’s come again.”
It's rare to find a place in Gangnam where you can comfortably fill your stomach at this price.
However, since dog wars break out during peak times, it is good for your mental health to aim for ambiguous times.

reviews.text:
A snack bar that tastes like your mother’s cooking. This is a place I always visit when I have a quick lunch by myself near Gangnam Station. There are a lot of people so you often have to wait, but the turnover rate is good so you don't have to wait long.
I mainly eat squid rice bowl, pork ssambap, pork stew pot, pork cutlet, and soft tofu :)

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text: I discovered another local gem here today. No color filter applied to the photo. Everything looks old but is surprisingly well maintained. The food was delicious and clean. I think this is the perfect restaurant if you want to eat home-cooked meals every day.

reviews.author: Cheon Seong-gil
reviews.text: I went around 2 o'clock and even though there were a lot of seats, the lady who seemed to be the owner spoke bluntly and told me to sit on the shelf because I came alone. He said he would sit at the guest table and use his smartphone while eating on the cramped shelf seat. The shelf seats are too narrow to eat comfortably. Customer service is unpleasant and the seats are uncomfortable. Regardless of cost-effectiveness and taste, I have no intention of visiting this restaurant again.

reviews.author: Disney Bug
reviews.text: This level of quality for 4,900 won... I guess it's possible because it's self-service in an underground shopping mall, right? You pay through the machine, and if you pay in cash, they give you a baked egg. The staff may be Korean-Chinese, but they talk very loudly in a foreign language. Soup, pickled radish, kimchi, sauce, etc. are all self-serve. As of 2020, all menu items do not exceed 6,000 won... I went into this place out of curiosity without any expectations, but it was quite a success.

reviews.author: Walk around the neighborhood
reviews.text:
25/1/15
I came to Gangnam Station and thought it would be a good place to grab a bite to eat after doing my banking, but it was cheap and served very quickly. Since it's rice noodles, it's not burdensome, and it seems like a good meal for one person.

reviews.author: JIMIL BAE
reviews.text: Located right below Exit 9 of Gangnam Station, this is a cheap pho restaurant that is great for eating alone. Ordering and pickup are self-service systems. The main dish, rice noodles, comes out almost 1-2 minutes after ordering, making it great for a quick meal. In addition to this, menu items such as fried rice and bun cha are also reasonably delicious. However, after several visits, the amount of buncha changed almost randomly every day, which was disappointing, so please keep this in mind. Also, cilantro is not provided unless specifically mentioned, so if you need cilantro, it will be provided if you ask for it. During peak hours, there are quite a few customers compared to the size of the store, so it is crowded, so if you don't like a cluttered atmosphere, we recommend visiting a little after meal time!

reviews.author: ty Kim
reviews.text: This is a pho noodle restaurant that you can enjoy casually. I don't think there's any place near Gangnam Station where you can get this dish at this price. There's a cheap pho restaurant near the old Woosung Apartment, but I think the soup here is affordable and the portions are good. The fried rice seemed to be a little small in quantity and had a strong Southeast Asian spice flavor, so I think people would have different opinions. It's a place where you can get a quick and simple meal, and I think it's especially perfect for cold weather like these days. :)

reviews.author: Ram WOo
reviews.text:
Since it’s a chain restaurant, the reviews on the taste are so-so.
It was around 3 o'clock, so I knew it was probably time for the employees to take a break after fighting a battle, but their expressions were dark.
Still, I thought there was a need to show hospitality even though I wasn't a member of the family, and since Buddha's birthday was approaching, I sat down with a compassionate heart and ordered various things with my companions.

Some people in your group may have bad teeth, so be merciful about that too.
pass~ When I had eaten about half of my meal, my friend and I had pho.

Curly rice noodles were excluded from the calculation.
Since then, I haven't been able to eat much.

It's not that the clerks are particularly unfriendly, but it feels a bit burdensome to talk to them. There are a lot of seats, but they fill up quickly during peak hours.
Not bad for just a meal.

reviews.author: BH Park
reviews.text:
It's open 24 hours a day, and although it's a bit out of the way, it's a pretty good place as it's conveniently located.
When you look from the outside after work on a weekday, it's easy to think it's full because there are so many people, but when you actually go in, the inside is spacious and there's never been a wait.

reviews.text: This is a restaurant with the concept of Taiwanese food. To be honest, the beef noodle tastes just average. It is difficult to compare it to the local taste in Taiwan, it tasted like meat noodles. It had plenty of ingredients, and I liked that it wasn't salty. The fried dumplings tasted better than the main menu item, the noodles. It was large, chewy, and well-cooked so it was crispy.

reviews.author: W Chung
reviews.text:
Dumplings are delicious. Next time, I’ll have to try steamed dumplings.
The dumplings were full and still good to eat even though they weren't juicy. I think they emphasize the juiciness, but it wasn't very juicy. Anyway, it tastes good.
I liked it because it was a non-irritating beef stew noodle. It is called Hong Kong tableware, but I would say it is simpler than what is commonly known. It doesn't feel thick or salty. However, that doesn't mean the soup is bland. It has a bit of a Korean beef bone soup taste. You can add more seasoning and adjust the taste. It's clean.
There aren't many people in the evening. I think it would be okay to have a drink. Please be kind.

(Additional comment)
The taste of the noodles comes and goes. This is a delicious dumpling restaurant.

reviews.text: I found this store by chance while looking for Korean pancakes. It is located on the first basement floor of this building. The owner was really friendly and even provided us with homemade makgeolli. The makgeolli was refreshing and smooth. I ordered seafood pancakes and the portion was really big! There are also plenty of chives and seafood ingredients! It's really delicious when eaten with garlic soy sauce. The side menu is also really delicious! If you go to a store nearby, be sure to stop by!

reviews.author: R K
reviews.text: This restaurant is located in one corner of the underground food court. It is run by an old couple, and the grandfather personally makes the pomegranate and lotus root flavored makgeolli. The special menu items here are father’s towel (be sure to try it!) and chicken stew. You can also order mung bean glutinous rice. The service is great and the food is really delicious. It's one of my favorite restaurants in the area. ​​It’s open until 11 p.m.

reviews.text: It's a new Thai restaurant in the neighborhood, but the overall taste is sour and vague. It's a shame that the pad thai noodles are spread out and dry and the peanut powder is thick. Will it get better after a while? Will I be able to survive on this expensive land?

reviews.author: Dongmin Lee
reviews.text: The inside of the restaurant is not small, but it fills up very quickly during lunch. I ordered pad thai and moo pin set. The Pad Thai felt a little more sour than commercial Pad Thai, and I thought it had a less Southeast Asian feel, but as I was eating it, I realized there was no cilantro. I guess I had to ask for the cilantro separately so I had to eat it. If I visit again, I think I'll add cilantro or try a different menu.

I remember the pad thai was so-so. I arrived around 1:10 on Saturday and there were two or three seats left.

Order basic tonkotsu ramen

reviews.author: Coupang Natural 3-ply Pulp
reviews.text:
This is a ramen restaurant located in Gangnam Station.

It's nothing more or less than a typical prefabricated ramen restaurant. The noodles were ordinary and the seasoning was too salty for me personally (I tend to like ramen salty). The tripe is well-seasoned and savory.

The lunch wait is quite long.

reviews.author: Ji Heon Ahn
reviews.text: I always went to Gangnam Station, but now the bus stop is different, so I looked for it and came to know about it. The first floor only has bar seating, which was nice because it had a sophisticated interior and a very high ceiling. You can order at the kiosk at your seat. I added noodles to the tonkotsu ramen, and the overall soup taste was rich and heavy. The doneness of the noodles and char siu is just right. First of all, what I personally regret is that considering the price, the ajitamago is only half a piece and despite the addition of noodles, it is not much different from other stores. At ㅇㄹㄴ, I feel quite full after eating one bowl and adding half the noodles, but the portion is definitely less than this. They do provide small bowls of rice for free. Also, I was a little disappointed that the minced garlic in the soup was a little too overcooked, leaving a slightly bitter taste at the end. Overall, it's a pretty good ramen restaurant, so I plan to visit often.

reviews.author: Jiyoung Lee

Even though I don't really like ramen, I enjoyed it.
The hormone dong is also sweet and delicious.

reviews.author: Trip Cat
reviews.text: Here’s a review of 851 Bokdon Rice Bowl! 🤩 I was impressed by the owner’s kindness and the sweet and sour delicious menu items. I also received a soda as part of the review event. The plentiful side dishes such as seaweed soup, seasoned tofu, radish radish, and pickled onions, as well as shrimp paste, Bomdong yukhoe bibimbap, Jeongjeong rice bowl, and yukhoe salmon bibimbap were all excellent. In particular, the salmon rice bowl was so popular that it was sold out and only the last plate was available for the evening, but I was really grateful that the owner gave me extra salmon sauce and shrimp sauce as a service. Be sure to stop by when you visit Gangnam! 💖

reviews.author: a N
reviews.text:
Visited on 2023.09.08
There is a bit of a line during weekday lunches, but the turnover is so fast that it's worth the wait.
Food also comes out quickly.

Order beef soup noodle / steamed dumpling 4P / grilled dumpling 4P

The portions may seem small, but the broth, noodles, and rice are all refillable for free, so you can eat as much as you want.
It tastes good and the seasoning is just right.
It's so good to eat kimchi with just the noodles,
This is the kind of kimchi that goes really well with kalguksu (noodle soup).
I highly recommend the noodle + kimchi combination.

For dumplings, I recommend fried dumplings rather than steamed dumplings.
They seem to be the same dumplings, but the steamed dumplings are saltier than the grilled ones.
The fried dumplings are really good.

This restaurant is crowded with people for a reason.
I think I come here often when I crave deep bone broth.

reviews.author: Sunghee Shin
reviews.text:
Wan Chai-myeon is a really, really good restaurant!!!!!
First of all, you must definitely eat the dumplings here. It’s a must, 5 stars!! Dumplings are literally so soft on the outside🤤 I really, really love dumplings, so I’ve eaten them a lot here and there, and the dumplings at Wan Chai are truly the dumplings of my life ㅠㅠ❣
There are times when I go just for the dumplings, and it's common to order dumplings twice.

And beef soup noodle!!
Beef soup noodle soup and noodles are unlimited refills ㅠㅠ Crazy..
I like cilantro, so I asked for cilantro and added a lot of it. The soup was very refreshing and the noodles were very smooth and delicious.
Wan Chai Myeongga is great for hangovers the day after drinking, and is so delicious just by itself.
Always recommended!

reviews.author: Lee Ha-eun
reviews.text:
This is a 24-hour store that offers unlimited hotpot refills at Gangnam Station!
Soju & beer in the middle of Gangnam are only 2,000 won!!!

The store is large and the seats are well divided, making it a more comfortable place to eat, and there is also group seating, making it a suitable place for corporate dinners and gatherings.
Uplift the mood with interior design that makes you feel like you're overseas!

The ingredients are neatly prepared and fresh.
There is a variety of seafood, noodles, meat, vegetables, etc. to choose from, and there is also a sauce bar so you can enjoy it however you like.

There were two kinds of broth, red soup and white soup, and like Chongqing-style hot pot, it had a more spicy taste than other places, so I really felt the flavor of the meat.

In addition, I wanted to go more often because of the side dishes that were like the main dish. The mapo tofu, fried rice, and kewobaroo were so delicious👍🏻

The fruit, donuts, and ice cream desserts were perfect~

reviews.text:
sheep
There is definitely a lot of meat. When it first came out, I thought, ‘Oh, there’s a lot of meat?’ However, there are a lot more bean sprouts than noodles, so when you eat it, you are confused as to whether it is rice noodles or bean sprout soup. The balance is a bit disappointing.

taste
Honestly, the taste was bland. There is almost no local feel, and the soup is weakly seasoned, so it does not have a deep flavor. There is almost no scent of coriander, and it would be more accurate to say it is bland rather than clean. The quality of the meat wasn't bad, but the flavor of the broth was weak, so it was boring overall.

price
The price is 14,000 won. I understand that it's expensive because it's Gangnam, but honestly, the price is too much for this taste. The visuals are okay, but the taste and perfection aren't worth the price. It's okay once in a while, but I wouldn't go back again.

Comprehensive evaluation
The quantity was plentiful, but the taste and value for money were disappointing. If you are expecting the rich flavor of local cuisine, you may be disappointed. Overall, it feels like a ‘rice noodle restaurant with a lot of portions and a bland taste.’

reviews.author: S Y
reviews.text:
I went around 3pm on a Sunday and there was no wait so I went right in, but there were hardly any empty seats in the store.

The seating arrangement inside the store is crowded.

There was a kiosk menu at each seat, so the tables were narrower. Still, if I asked for something to store my luggage, they gave me something like a basket.

You can order right away at the kiosk, and pay at the counter when you leave!

- One-time free bean sprout/noodle/rice refill available when ordering rice noodle menu

The basic side dishes were onions, peppers, and water. I thought it was warm tea, but it was cold tea. Still, it's nice to have a car.

If you apply the set while ordering rice noodles, you get a 500 won discount, so I ordered it for 3,000 won.

Gopchang noodles are famous here, and I wanted spicy food, so I ordered spicy beef tripe rice noodles (16,000 won) at level 1. Delicious.

The amount of tripe was generous and it was spicier than I expected. I think level 0 would have been spicy at this level.

Because there was giblet oil, it wasn't exactly spicy, but rather spicy, but it wasn't as savory as I expected, so it was just that. The ending taste is bitter.

Our group ordered brisket rice noodles (11,000 won).

It tasted like regular rice noodles, so the soup was delicious and there was plenty of meat and noodles.

The spicy beef tripe pho is famous, but the regular pho is even better, so if I visit again, I'll have to order something other than the spicy pho.

It was nice that the portions were generous and refills were available.

reviews.author: Garam Park
reviews.text: As of July 21, I discovered a newly opened Thai restaurant in Yeoksam-dong while looking for Pad Thai. The entrance and interior decoration, which gives the illusion of lush greenery, are very nice. Even better is tableware. The wide wooden tray and wooden spatula are unusual.  There are 4 kinds of sauces on the table, but I really need some fish sauce.  The pad thai was seasoned well, but it didn't have the flavor I was used to, so adding fish sauce brought out the flavor. Personally, I don't like crunchy bean sprouts, so I put the hot fried noodles on top of the bean sprouts and waited for a while before eating them. The green curry is not that green, but it has a strong coconut milk taste. It was a bit spicy, but it had a bit of spiciness to it. I still found it a bit spicy... but I can't eat spicy ramen, so the person I went with said it wasn't spicy. Ordinary Koreans seem to enjoy it. It was good because there were plenty of ingredients so there was a lot to eat. When I left, I was told that it was made from snacks. Next time, I want to try other menu items besides Pad Thai and green curry. A restaurant where you can look forward to a different menu.

reviews.text:
One-line review: Southeast Asian restaurant worth eating when using Beopka, the closest to Yeoksam Station

It's a restaurant located in the middle of the basement of GFC, so the interior and atmosphere make you feel like you're sitting in a cafeteria... The service is average, and the prices are higher than the average for Dong's lunch, but it seems reasonable based on the standard of Beopka usage. (13,000 ~30,000 won)
It's a bit difficult to see it as an advantage, but... I ordered 5 dishes, and they came out really quickly(?). I don't think it took a total of 15 minutes... Among the Thai restaurants I've been to, the speed is the best.😂

If the taste is this good, it is worth eating without much liking or disliking. Rather than saying that the seasoning is appropriate for all dishes, it is seasoned strongly and generously from the beginning, so although you may receive complaints that the seasoning is too strong, you will not be told that it is not delicious. A friend of mine who has been to other Saint-Augustin branches said that this one tastes better than other branches...

Anyway, I think it would be a bit disappointing if I had to pay out of my own pocket, but I think I would feel quite satisfied if I ate Beopka for lunch or during a meeting.^^

p.s. I liked that if I asked for more cilantro, they gave me a generous amount.
